propositions: Primary-run completion verification exhausts the token budget before verifying all criteria, then per-criterion recovery fan-out repeats work at 1.8x cost (22×20 req = 440 vs primary 240); banked verdicts from the primary are discarded wholesale on failure.

The flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 floor hands low-criteria tickets ~10x the budget they need; a criteria-scaled floor verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c,48,480) makes typical tickets converge without recovery, reducing recovery invocation.

Successive verify runs reread the same file ranges from disk at different line_start/line_end pairs, bypassing memo deduplication; normalizing the memo key by path collapses the 77% re-read tax to a single cached whole-file read per path per run.

On primary exhaustion, record criterion verdicts incrementally to a run-scoped bank during the primary run, resume successor batches (≤8 criteria/batch) over only unverified criteria, merge all banked+successor verdicts at finalize, and emit a full-coverage verdict with unverified criteria as met=false placeholders rather than verdict-less failure.

Successor pool allocation is deterministic from criteria count: N=ceil(verify_step_floor(c)/2), global_pool=1.5×N, successor_pool=global−primary_spend, per-run allocation is floor(remaining_pool/remaining_runs); a batch smaller than the launch floor (B≥2×batch_size) shrinks and re-plans until launchable or pool exhausted.

On finalizer failure with a non-empty bank, emit a deterministic no-LLM full-coverage verdict (banked verdicts as-is, unbanked as met=false unverified), stamp finalizer=deterministic_fallback and certifiable=false on the sidecar to signal skipped cross-criterion downgrade authority, closing the verdict-less trap.
